## Behavior and evidence

## Security and operations

- [ ] I considered authentication, authorization, secrets, personal data and outbound network access.
- [ ] Irreversible side effects have an approval/idempotency boundary.
- [ ] State, retry, timeout, upgrade and rollback behavior are documented where relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, real-person media or generated local state are included.

## Supply chain and licensing

- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, bounded and license-compatible.
- [ ] Imported code/assets retain provenance, copyright and license notices.
- [ ] Skill/signature claims distinguish byte identity from code safety.
